entities.name: PMID:27496865
observations: EGFR-mutant mouse model: alveolar-macrophage expansion tracked tumor progression; depletion reduced tumor burden. Human activation-signature association with unfavorable survival was observational.

entities.name: PMID:32125091
observations: In an inducible EGFR-mutant mouse model, clodronate depletion targeting alveolar macrophages reduced tumor proliferation/burden more than interstitial-macrophage targeting; CD8 T-cell infiltration increased.

entities.name: PMID:37131637
observations: Tumor-associated alveolar macrophages use GM-CSF–PPARγ signaling and cholesterol efflux to support tumor EGFR phosphorylation and growth; disrupting support restrains progression in models.

entities.name: EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma
observations: Experimental models show alveolar macrophages can promote tumor burden and oncogenic EGFR signaling; clinical generalizability is not established by these studies.

entities.name: Alveolar macrophage
observations: Tumor-associated alveolar macrophages can support EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma growth; their depletion reduced tumor burden in mouse models.

entities.name: AM depletion reduces tumors
observations: Depleting alveolar macrophages reduced tumor burden in EGFR-mutant mouse lung adenocarcinoma models; this supports a causal contribution in models, not universal human dependence.

entities.name: AM cholesterol supports EGFR
observations: Tumor GM-CSF induces macrophage PPARγ-dependent cholesterol export; this supports tumor-cell EGFR phosphorylation and growth in experimental EGFR-driven lung adenocarcinoma.
